articles.question: How do I flag entries and submit a CBP reconciliation entry?
articles.answer: To participate in the 21-month CBP Reconciliation Program, navigate to CBP Reconciliation under Post-Entry, flag eligible entry summaries for reconcilable issues, and bundle flagged entries into a reconciliation entry for transmission.
steps: Navigate to Post-Entry and select CBP Reconciliation Program (/app/post-entry/cbp-reconciliation).
Fill out the Flag an entry form with the entry number, entry date, estimated duty difference, and reconcilable issues (Value, Classification, FTA Eligibility, or Section 9802).
Click Flag entry to place the entry in the tracked reconciliation queue.
Enter a reconciliation entry number and click Prepare to bundle all open flagged entries.
Click Transmit on the prepared entry card to transmit the reconciliation header to CBP.

articles.question: How do I track and manage ACH duty statement payments?
articles.answer: To manage ACH payment instructions for CBP statements, navigate to Duty Statement Payments under Post-Entry, create payment instructions for daily or Periodic Monthly Statements, monitor payment deadlines, and update status lifecycle states.
steps: Navigate to Post-Entry and select Duty Statement Payments (/app/post-entry/duty-payments).
Click New instruction and enter the statement number, statement type (Daily or Periodic Monthly), statement date, filer code, and duty and fee amounts.
Optionally provide the payer account number to retain the last four digits for reference.
Click Create to record the ACH payment instruction and calculate payment deadlines.
Use action buttons on each statement card to advance status through scheduled, submitted, settled, or failed states.

articles.question: How do I monitor ABI fatal error rates and filer compliance health?
articles.answer: To monitor your account's 19 CFR 143 Subpart A broker compliance, navigate to Filer Admin Health under Post-Entry to inspect your ABI fatal error rate percentage, connection status, credential state, and export history.
steps: Navigate to Post-Entry and select Filer Admin Health (/app/post-entry/filer-health).
Review the configured filer code, filer name, and overall health compliance indicator.
Check the fatal error rate metric calculated against the 19 CFR 143.5 5% maximum threshold over the active monitoring window.
Verify connection status, ABI environment details, credential status, and transport protocols.
Inspect recent export errors to identify and troubleshoot fatal ABI transmission issues.

articles.question: How do I prepare and submit an Importer Security Filing (ISF 10+2)?
articles.answer: To prepare and submit an ISF 10+2 filing, navigate to ISF 10+2 Filings under Post-Entry, create a draft with shipment and bill of lading details, complete missing 10+2 elements, and submit the filing before the 24-hour pre-lading deadline.
steps: Navigate to Post-Entry and select ISF 10+2 Filings (/app/post-entry/isf).
Click New ISF draft and enter the shipment ID, bill of lading number, and lading date and time.
Complete the 10+2 element fields including seller, buyer, importer of record, consignee, manufacturer, ship-to party, country of origin, and HTS code.
Review filing deadlines, missing element warnings, bond coverage, and estimated penalty exposure on the draft card.
Click Submit ISF to transmit the declaration to CBP.

articles.question: How do I calculate penalty exposure and submit a prior disclosure?
articles.answer: To model Section 1592 penalty exposure and record a prior disclosure, navigate to Prior Disclosure under Post-Entry, enter violation details, calculate statutory exposure based on culpability level, and log the tender record.
steps: Navigate to Post-Entry and select Prior Disclosure (§1592) (/app/post-entry/prior-disclosure).
Enter the entry number or filing ID, violation description, actual duty loss, and entered value.
Select the culpability level (Negligence, Gross Negligence, or Fraud) and set the interest rate and years elapsed.
Preview the calculated statutory penalty exposure capped under 19 U.S.C. § 1592.
Click Save disclosure record to log the prior disclosure tender and track status through acknowledgment and closure.
